notes.title: About next ver 1.11 and new character
notes.content:
Sorry I don't give update in this post for while, lately I've been busy with my work. In the next version (V1.11) it will be big update because more area can be explore, new ghosts, new character, and new mechanic.

Talking about new character,
I give you sketch based on poll in my twitter and my itchio few days ago

The result is :
- Short pants + long socks : 18%
- Short skirt + long socks : 82%

This new character will appear in LIRE chapter 2 sketch for short skirt + long socks

[url=https://ibb.co/HhcWBCx][img]https://i.ibb.co/HhcWBCx/New-concept.jpg[/img][/url]

I will explain more about next update, and new character in my Youtube Channel
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCL9YKTrW-eUgHi8GvjFyeDA

Subscribe wil appreacciate it.
